newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries jump higher on contained CPI news.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries jump higher on contained CPI news.

text.p: Data indicating inflation remained under wraps in December sparked a sharp rally in the prices of U.S. Treasury securities Tuesday.
The 30-year closed a full point higher at 96-17/32 to yield 6.77 percent Tuesday.

The Labor Department reported that the Consumer Price Index rose 0.3 percent as expected, while to "core" rate -- excluding the volatile food and energy components -- rose a slightly less-than-expected 0.1 percent.
